exposure: Threatened abortion in the first trimester
cohort: The study included 61 cases of women presenting with threatened abortion whose pregnancies continued beyond 20 weeks of gestation, and 72 controls whose pregnancies also continued beyond 20 weeks of gestation.
finding: Pregnancies with first-trimester threatened abortion were associated with a higher incidence of premature rupture of membranes, manual removal of placenta, IUGR, intrauterine death, stillbirth, and neonatal death compared to controls, suggesting threatened abortion is a predictive factor for adverse late trimester maternal and fetal outcomes.
followup_time: Up to neonatal death (shortly after birth)
